title: Input template matches tableau instruction bits
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $n,T,t,p\in\mathbb N$, let $z$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $\theta$ be one of the seven input phases. Suppose $p<|z|+n+2$, $t\le T$, and let $e$ be a register record whose input-count and hard-wired-input-length registers equal $n$ and $|z|$, whose current-instruction register is the tableau position for input cell $(t,p)$, and whose step-start register is $t$ times the configuration stride. If $t\ne0$, assume its preceding-cell register plus one stride equals its current-instruction register. Assume also that the phase’s source list agrees with the prescribed input-cell sources, that its layout source selects the corresponding hard-wired input bit when $1\le p\le |z|+n$ and is false otherwise, and that this layout source is valid for the register record. Then executing the template for the input cell of phase $\theta$ produces exactly the bit string of the corresponding tableau instruction.
